name: Input Group
summary: An input group is a text field with a button or a text affix joined to its edge: search and submit, a password reveal, a copy button. The addon is a real sibling in a flex row, never an overlay, because an overlay covers the value at 200% zoom.
demoNote: Zoom to 200% and watch the addon narrow the field instead of covering the text. Press Show and then Copy, and compare how each button reports what happened.

contract.useWhen: A text field with a button or an affix joined to its edge, both reachable at 200% zoom.
keyboard: native: the addon is a real sibling, so it is its own stop
native: submits the form from the field, activates the focused addon
native: activates the focused addon button
failureModes: the button absolutely positioned over the input, so it swallows clicks meant for the text
